comparison.objective: Transfer a sterile device cord off-field, route it through a holder, and plug it into a console without contamination.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable-cord handoff, zone-constrained handling, alignment, and connector insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Connector inserted at least 15 mm within axis tolerances, cord in slot, both arms released, and no contamination event.
comparison.reason: Sterile-zone cable handoff and insertion are different from rigid mechanical adjustment and dynamic shock-absorber validation.
